correctness.rationale: For every odd q and smooth ordered coefficients (a,b), Frobenius commutes with the regular Klein-four action on each reciprocal quartic, so a quartic contributes identity or 2^2 involution, never a 4-cycle; splitting count is S=(q-1-gcd(4,q-1))/4 and nonsplit U=q-2-S. The hyperelliptic even-subset/complement 6-dimensional symplectic model gives 135 geometric maximal isotropic 3-spaces. The 105 perfect-matching subgroups are distinct; the other 30 are the S8/AGL(3,2) affine spaces. Their fixed-point counts follow from invariant matchings (105,9,25) and affine centralizers (30,6,14), hence 135,15,39. Group descent is Frobenius invariance, not an assumption of individually rational generators; rational 2-torsion sizes 64,16,16 are independently reproduced. The claimed ordered-pair frequencies include q=3 empty case and every kernel splits over q². Verified actual RESULT.md and verify_isotropic.py at their frozen blob hashes and independently enumerated 64 even-subset classes/135 isotropic subspaces and three Frobenius actions. Finite-field script examples do not prove all q; the analytic group action does.
